_note: Canonical News & Events + Achievements content, transcribed from sksworldschoolnoida.ac.in/our-events and /achievements. Used two ways: (1) the Next.js pages import it via lib/newsFallback.ts as the static fallback when the backend API is unreachable; (2) backend/scripts/seed-data.js requires it to seed MongoDB. Keep dates as ISO strings; ambiguous 'Month YYYY' labels are pinned to the 1st.

news.title: Trip to McDonald's
news.description: A fun-filled outing for Pre-Nursery to Class 1. Children relished their favourite meals and learned about table manners and sharing with friends.

news.title: Bloom's Taxonomy Workshop
news.description: A teacher development session by Varun Sharma, author of Communicating Over Troubled Waters, on using Bloom's Taxonomy to make teaching more effective and engaging.

news.title: Workshop on POCSO
news.description: A child-safety awareness session by Ms. Namrata covering key provisions of the Act and the role of teachers in ensuring child safety.

news.title: Annual Sports Meet
news.description: A day-long athletic celebration of drills, races, chess and badminton — full of energy, sportsmanship and proud moments.

news.title: FUNFINITY Fair
news.description: A campus-wide creative showcase, from the exhibition to the high-energy Fun Zone, with student work displays and interactive activities.

news.title: Victory Adventure Camp
news.description: A two-phase outdoor experience for Mont to Class 8 with zip line, trampoline, commando crawl, burma bridge and tug of war, with meals provided.

news.title: Veer Baal Diwas
news.description: A commemorative assembly honouring the courage and sacrifice of the Sahibzades.

news.title: Handwashing Awareness Programme
news.description: In partnership with the Physical Education Foundation of India, the Illness to Wellness Foundation and Savlon, Mr. Yogesh Sharma guided students through the seven steps of effective handwashing.

news.title: Strengthening Assessment and Evaluation Workshop
news.description: A session to enhance teachers' proficiency in formative and summative assessment — Bloom's Taxonomy-based question design, SMART learning outcomes, the LAAR cycle, Competency Based Education and portfolio integration.

news.title: CBSE Joyful Mathematics Workshop — Middle Stage
news.description: Strengthening the teaching and learning of Mathematics through activity-based, conceptual and student-centred methods, with a Back to Basics approach and a focus on common student errors.

news.title: Python Workshop for Teachers
news.description: A teacher development session mentored by Ms. Leena Lakhanpal and Ms. Jyoti Arora, introducing Python programming for the classroom alongside a discussion on the mental health and well-being of children.

news.title: Inter-School Competition — SYNERGIA-3: Harmonizing Talent
news.description: A multi-school event of debate, storytelling, dance, music, art and sports. Mayoor School, Noida emerged as the overall trophy winner.

news.title: Capacity Building Programme: Mental Health and Wellness
news.description: A programme for teachers on emotional and behavioural issues in children, teacher well-being, the school counsellor's role, adolescence and the benefits of meditation.

news.title: Cyber Security and a Safe Digital Future
news.description: Ms. Laxmi (Police Commissionerate), DIG Rajiv Narayan Mishra and Sub-Inspector Sachin Yadav spoke on strong passwords, careful sharing of personal information, and staying alert against online frauds and cyberbullying.

news.title: Fire Safety Awareness — No Crackers Diwali
news.description: Mr. Yogendra Chaurasia encouraged a celebration without smoke or noise and demonstrated fire-safety measures such as handling diyas carefully and keeping water nearby.

news.title: Grandparents' Day Celebration
news.description: Pre-Nursery to Prep welcomed grandparents with songs, dances, games, special performances and handmade cards as tokens of love.

news.title: Mahavatar Narsimha — Movie Outing
news.description: An animated film screening exploring devotion, courage and divine intervention through the story of Bhakt Prahlad and Lord Narsimha, reinforcing faith, resilience and righteousness.

news.title: CBSE Social Science Workshop
news.description: Held at Cambridge School, Sector 27, Noida and facilitated by Ms. Shivani Chaudhary and Ms. Ritu Goel on Competency Based Assessment and creating quality questions.

news.title: KidZania Educational Trip
news.description: Mont and Grade 1 students became doctors, chefs, pilots and firefighters for the day, earning KidZania money by completing tasks and learning to be creative and work as a team.

news.title: Special Assembly — Doctors' Day, Sugar Awareness & Affirmations
news.description: A student-led assembly marking National Doctors' Day, raising awareness about reducing sugar intake, and sharing positive daily affirmations for well-being.

news.title: Mock Drill
news.description: An emergency-preparedness exercise for students and staff.

news.title: School Elections
news.description: Students took part in the democratic process to elect the school council — candidates presented their vision confidently and students voted responsibly.

news.title: Mother's Day Celebration
news.description: Games, competitions and talent shows in honour of mothers, including nail art, artificial bouquet making, best out of waste and fireless cooking.

news.title: Dental Check-up Programme
news.description: An oral-health camp by Ratra's Dental Clinic that examined students and raised awareness about the importance of regular dental care.

news.title: Kiran Nadar Museum Educational Tour
news.description: Grades VI–VIII visited the museum for exposure to contemporary and modern art.

news.title: Halloween Celebration
news.description: Montessori and Class 1 festivities with costumes and craft.

news.title: Synergia 2024
news.description: A multi-institutional creative showcase hosted on campus.

news.title: Class III A Special Assembly — Dussehra
news.description: A dance performance and soulful songs paying tribute to Lord Rama and the triumph of good over evil.

news.title: Kohinoor Biscuit Factory Visits
news.description: Classes 2–4 witnessed biscuit-making, learned about quality control and sampled fresh biscuits.

news.title: Trip to McDonald's — Montessori & Class 1
news.description: Montessori and Class 1 visited McDonald's and learned about teamwork, hand hygiene and customer service.

news.title: National Space Day
news.description: A celebration of the Chandrayaan-3 success with colouring contests, slogan writing and painting activities.

news.title: Janmashtami Celebration
news.description: Class 1 presented a dance and skit on Krishna's life while other classes crafted props and handmade cards.

news.title: 78th Independence Day
news.description: Flag-hoisting, a student assembly, a Class 3 C dance and tricolour crafts, with a choir rendition of Ekla Chalo Re.

news.title: Raksha Bandhan
news.description: Nursery to Class 8 made rakhis and cards celebrating the bond between brothers and sisters.

news.title: Staff Health Check-up
news.description: In partnership with Felix Hospital — blood pressure, blood sugar, BMI and lipid profile screening, plus visual acuity tests and retinoscopy.

news.title: CBSE Workshop: Bal Vatika and Jadui Pitara
news.description: Held at Delhi World Public School, Noida Extension for around 200 teachers and 75 principals, facilitated by Ms. Yashika on effective teaching methodologies.

news.title: International Yoga Day
news.description: Students and staff took part in a guided yoga session on campus.

news.title: 75th Republic Day Celebration
news.description: Flag-hoisting by Principal Mrs. Rachna Agarwal, a special student assembly and craft activities in a vibrant spirit of patriotism.

news.title: Veer Gatha 4.0 — Gallantry Honours
news.description: Students paid tribute to India's Gallantry Award winners through heartfelt creations celebrating their valour and sacrifice.

news.title: Guru Dakshita Induction Training
news.description: A CBSE programme for principals and teachers covering the structure, policies and guidelines of all CBSE departments, aligned with NEP 2020.

news.title: Inter-School Competition
news.description: Classes Nursery to VIII from multiple schools took part — a reminder that inter-school competitions are about personal growth and learning, not only winning.

achievements.title: AISSE Result — Session 2024-25
achievements.description: The school's students appeared for the CBSE All India Secondary School Examination (Class X) for the 2024-25 session, continuing SKS World School's record of consistent board results.

achievements.title: India's Most Trusted Education Brand of the Year Award 2025
achievements.description: SKS World School was recognised among India's Most Trusted Education Brands of the Year for 2025.

achievements.title: British Council International School Award
achievements.description: Awarded for Outstanding Development of the International Dimension in the Curriculum, recognising the school's work in nurturing global citizenship in students. The International School Award (ISA) was conferred for the 2018-21 cycle, with the ceremony held on 5 December 2018 in Delhi.

achievements.title: School of India Award
achievements.description: The school has been featured in the School of India awards, which recognise institutions for excellence in school education.
